mapper.select: select m.member_id as memberId, m.member_no as memberNo, m.phone as phone, m.nickname as nickname, m.level_id as levelId, m.level_name as levelName, ifnull(l.discount_rate, 1.00) as discountRate, m.points as points, ifnull(b.total_balance, 0.00) as balanceTotal, m.status as status from biz_member m left join biz_member_level l on l.level_id = m.level_id left join biz_member_balance b on b.member_id = m.member_id where m.phone = #{keyword} or m.member_no = #{keyword} limit 1

select m.member_id as memberId, m.member_no as memberNo, m.phone as phone, m.nickname as nickname, m.level_id as levelId, m.level_name as levelName, ifnull(l.discount_rate, 1.00) as discountRate, m.points as points, ifnull(b.total_balance, 0.00) as balanceTotal, m.status as status from biz_member m left join biz_member_level l on l.level_id = m.level_id left join biz_member_balance b on b.member_id = m.member_id where m.member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
select ifnull(principal_balance, 0.00) from biz_member_balance where member_id = #{memberId}

select c.coupon_id as couponId, c.coupon_code as couponCode, c.coupon_name as couponName, c.face_value as faceValue, c.threshold_amount as thresholdAmount, c.valid_end as validEnd from biz_coupon c where c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.status = 1 and (c.valid_end is null or c.valid_end >= now()) order by c.valid_end asc
select count(*) from biz_borrow where member_id = #{memberId} and status in (1, 3)
select count(*) from biz_borrow where member_id = #{memberId} and status = 3
